turns.user: ok so a few things, I'm starving today so I think I need more carbs, what should I have before training tomorrow morning, and is it fine that I skipped the stretching at the end yesterday
turns.reply:
Carbs today — your body is asking for energy, so add a solid portion of complex carbs to your next main meal: something like sweet potato, rice, or oats will fill you right up without blowing your targets.

Before training tomorrow — go for something fast-acting 30-60 minutes before: a banana, a slice of toast with honey, or a couple of rice cakes. They digest quickly so your body has instant fuel ready without sitting heavy while you train.

Skipping stretching — totally fine for one off day. Intra-workout movement and dynamic warm-ups do most of the real mobility work anyway, so missing a cool-down stretch won't set back your progress or recovery.
